applicability: any positive integer with two or more digits; if the result is still unclear (magnitude ≥ 10), apply the same rule to that result and continue until a small number remains. A number N is divisible by 7 iff, after one such reduction, the result is divisible by 7 (0, 7 or −7 when reduced to a small value).
carry_case: 1001 — one pass gives 100 − 2·1 = 98, which is not obviously a multiple of 7; the rule must be applied again: 9 − 2·8 = −7, which is divisible by 7, so 1001 is too.

steps.instruction: Double the last digit, subtract from the rest
